# A Bolero project is rooted at app.json. bolero mod init creates it,
# go.sum keeps its name, and a sibling go.mod is an error.

cd new
bolero mod init example.com/shop
stderr '^bolero: creating new app.json: module example.com/shop$'
! exists go.mod
! exists go.sum
grep '"module": "example.com/shop"' app.json
grep '"version": "0.1.0"' app.json
grep '"license": "MIT"' app.json
grep '"name": "Your Name"' app.json
grep '"email": "you@example.com"' app.json
! grep '"toolchain"' app.json
bolero env BOLERO_MOD
stdout 'app\.json$'

# Editing the manifest and loading a module writes go.sum, not go.mod.
bolero mod edit -require=rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2
bolero list -m -mod=mod all
stdout '^example.com/shop$'
stdout '^rsc.io/quote v1.5.2$'
exists go.sum
! exists go.mod
grep 'rsc.io/quote' app.json
grep 'Your Name' app.json

cd ../app
bolero mod init example.com/app
bolero mod edit -replace=example.com/dep=../dep -replace=example.com/dep2=../dep2
bolero mod tidy
! exists go.mod
grep 'example.com/dep' app.json
grep 'example.com/dep2' app.json
grep '"indirect"' app.json
grep 'Your Name' app.json
bolero run .
stdout '^hi$'

# An unrecognized field is an error.
cd ../bad
! bolero list
stderr 'unknown field "licence"'

# app.json and go.mod together are an error.
cd ../both
! bolero list
stderr 'app.json and go.mod both exist; a Bolero project uses app.json'

# init will not overwrite a go.mod file.
cd ../hasmod
! bolero mod init example.com/m
stderr 'go.mod already exists'

-- new/main.go --
package main

func main() {}
-- app/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/dep"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(dep.Hello())
}
-- dep/go.mod --
module example.com/dep

go 1.26

require example.com/dep2 v1.0.0
-- dep/p.go --
package dep

import "example.com/dep2"

func Hello() string {
	dep2.F()
	return "hi"
}
-- dep2/go.mod --
module example.com/dep2

go 1.26
-- dep2/p.go --
package dep2

func F() {}
-- bad/app.json --
{
	"module": "example.com/bad",
	"go": "1.26",
	"licence": "MIT"
}
-- both/app.json --
{
	"module": "example.com/both",
	"go": "1.26"
}
-- both/go.mod --
module example.com/both

go 1.26
-- hasmod/go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.26
